verdict: Organic presence is holding but fading; overdue pipeline work is the priority.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your combined 430 Google Business Profile actions — 108 for Forte Precision Metals, 117 for Advance Grinding Services, and 205 for O'Hare Precision Metals — represent the entirety of measurable commercial activity, as no paid spend ran on any channel over the last 28 days. GBP engagement is trending down at Forte (–22%) and O'Hare (–23%) week over week, while Advance held its own with a 15% uptick; organic search clicks are softening across all three brands as well. The more urgent issue is that a series of CRM, outreach, and web milestones — overdue since as far back as July — remain incomplete, which means the cold-email pipeline and CRM sync are not yet generating any activity to backstop the organic slowdown. Work to clear those blockers and reindex the three sites is in motion with an end-of-October target, and once complete, outreach sequences and automation will begin producing measurable pipeline alongside the organic channel.

watch_item.issue: Eight project milestones covering CRM reconciliation, contact outreach, and website indexing have been overdue since July–September, leaving the cold-email and CRM pipeline inactive during the organic slowdown.
watch_item.fix: Clearing those milestones is the current priority — site reindexing, contact pulls, and outreach sequences are all targeted for completion by end of October, with CRM automations to follow immediately after.
